details.description: Remove wax or polish residue and fingerprints with ease, with 3M's soft Microfibre Cloth. Our non-linting cloth is ideal for use on glass, metal, chrome, plastic, vinyl and leather surfaces, and has a unique high-absorbing texture.
details.usageInstructions:
Microfiber cloth can be used to wipe multiple surfaces of a car, such as painted surfaces, glass and plastic
It can be used to remove dirt as well as dry a wet surface after cleaning

details.description:
3M Glass Cleaner quickly dissolves and cuts through dirt, smudges, and bug splatter to reveal crystal clear windshields and car windows. Our formula is made to produce a streak-free shine. It's no-drip foaming formula clings to vertical surfaces, eliminating messy dripping or run-off. It is also safe on plastic, chrome, and metal surfaces. It perfectly cleans both tinted and non-tinted glasses, ensuring both safety and aesthetic appeal.
As you drive around through smoke and dust, your car glass is what protects you. 3M Glass Cleaner streak-free formula, removes all stains, be it film, grime, filth, or fingerprints, and is safe on all glass, metal and plastic parts.
Ready to use and safe for all glass, metal and plastic parts, this cleaner ensures quick removal of contaminants with minimal effort. It is a zero ammonia formulation which has no unpleasant smell and is safe for the user as well as the environment. In case of any overspray on painted surfaces, simply wipe it off without any worry.
details.usageInstructions:
Make sure the glass is cool and in the shade when you apply the cleaner
Shake the can before spraying
Spray glass cleaner uniformly on the glass surface
Wipe clean with a new 3M Microfiber Cloth after 3 seconds to 1 minute
Try it on the inside and the outside surface for maximum shine

details.description: 3M Attachment Tape is a high-performance acrylic foam tape commonly used across a wide range of interior and exterior applications within the professional automotive industry. Known for its strong bonding capability, it is ideal for securing spoilers, dashboard fittings, nameplates, emblems, logos, door visors, interior trim, chrome mirror covers, chrome handles, bold side mouldings, rocker mouldings, and bumper corner protectors.
details.usageInstructions:
Clean the surface areas, removing dirt & other contaminants
Stick the tape to one of the surfaces and then remove the liner
Now you can attach the second surface to the other side of the tape
Apply pressure to ensure proper adhesion
